name: Home
purpose: The app’s Home tab, as a user sees it once they’ve chosen some topics, set their council and visited some pages: the header and search, then the Topics, Your local services and Pages you’ve visited widgets, and a way to give feedback.
when: Prototyping a new widget on Home, or a change to one.
Prototyping a journey that starts on Home, such as from a topic or a page the user has visited.
Showing a new feature in the place a user would find it, in the app as it is.
screen: Home, the root of the Home tab, with its topics, local services and recent activity widgets

screens.title: Home
screens.description: The root of the Home tab. Your topics and All topics switch the topics shown; the local council and the pages visited open GOV.UK in the browser.

notes: The page has a comment at its top saying what to change and what to leave.
The topics, Edit, See all and Give feedback go nowhere, as the library has no screens for them. Give a row an href to a page of yours to make it open one.
Searching isn’t here: the field takes typing, but there are no results.
Chat and Settings on the tab bar open the Chat and Settings templates, if they’re beside this one.
